Student Takeaway:

THE BRAIN! Self-Attention mixes context across tokens, while FFN/MoE layers execute deep reasoning.

LLM Lab runs a real, mechanically accurate transformer forward pass entirely in your browser — tokenization, embeddings, attention, softmax, and sampling all really happen. The weights are randomly seeded rather than trained, so outputs are illustrative, not coherent model answers. No servers, no API calls, nothing leaves your device.
